purpose: Openly licensed published measurement data used to benchmark the app's pH, pure-CMC and mixed-CMC engines (scripts/open-reference-benchmark.ts; src/utils/__tests__/openReferenceBenchmark.regression.test.ts).
governance: Component-level reference benchmark only. These are not matched finished-formula lab batches, do not count toward REAL_LAB_DATA_COUNT, and never set LAB_VALIDATED.

datasets.content: Selected primary and secondary pH reference values (Tables 2 and 3) with engine recipe mapping and explicit coverage gaps.
datasets.source: R. P. Buck et al., Measurement of pH. Definition, standards, and procedures (IUPAC Recommendations 2002), Pure Appl. Chem. 74(11), 2169-2200 (2002)
datasets.license: IUPAC reproduction notice: republication or reproduction permitted without prior permission provided the source is acknowledged with full reference and the copyright symbol, the name IUPAC and the year.
datasets.transformation: Numeric values transcribed; engine_recipe and mapping_note columns added by this repository.

datasets.content: Filtered slice of the PSDI/NIST NSRDS-36 CMC table: compounds 1 (SDS), 21 (DDAO), 51 (SDBS), 121 (C12 betaine), 279 (C12 BDDAC); no additives, molar units, 20-30 C, evaluation codes 1/2/3/P/L.
datasets.source: Frey, J. G.; Pearman-Kanza, S.; Munday, S.; Allam, T. Critical Micelle Concentration (CMC) Data Collection, PSDI (2024), digitising Mukerjee & Mysels, NSRDS-NBS 36 (1971)
datasets.transformation: Row filter plus app mapping columns (app_cmc_key, app_ingredient_probe_name, structural_relationship, evidence_tier).

datasets.content: Binary surfactant mixture CMC values compiled from literature (SMILES, mole fraction, log10 CMC in micromolar).
datasets.source: Sandia National Laboratories P2SURF repository, file Mixture_surfactants_CMC/Case-1_Interpolating CMC at intermediate mole fraction/dataset/updated_CMC-Data-for-mixed-micelle.csv

excludedSources.name: SurfPro database
excludedSources.reason: CC BY-NC-SA licence is incompatible with commercial use; remains do-not-ingest per evidence_vault/datasets policy.
